rows.details: School of Horticulture Science & Technology, Mountain Agriculture Research and Extension Station, Kargil
Geo-Referenced Inventory and Spatial Mapping of Apricot and Other Fruit Trees in Kargil District, Ladakh Using GPS, GIS and Drone Technology
Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 37,000/- per month (+ 10% HRA for JRF)

content_sections.heading: About UoL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The University of Ladakh conducts this recruitment through the Office of the Dean Horticulture Sciences, School of Horticulture Science & Technology, Mountain Agriculture Research and Extension Station, Kargil. The positions are purely temporary and established under the MIDH-funded research initiative titled “Geo-Referenced Inventory and Spatial Mapping of Apricot and Other Fruit Trees in Kargil District, Ladakh Using GPS, GIS and Drone Technology”.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 02 vacancies are available across two distinct positions under the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF), the age limit is as per applicable rules. The notice does not specify an age limit for Project Assistant.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc./M.Tech. in Remote Sensing, GIS, Geoinformatics or related discipline or M.Sc. in Horticulture/Agriculture with working knowledge of GIS, GPS and Drone Technology
rows.desirable: Knowledge/experience in GIS, GPS, Remote Sensing, drone/UAV technology, spatial mapping and data analysis

rows.essential_qualification: B.Sc. Agriculture with desirable knowledge of computer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment for both positions is co-terminus with the project, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds. The project duration is 3 years. Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- per month + 10% HRA. Project Assistant: 18000 per month fixed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Gather self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents. Submit the application along with the detailed CV and self-attested copies by email to [email protected] on or before 28 October 2026. Candidates with queries may contact the Office Landline No: 9422597895.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Self-attested copies of educational qualifications Self-attested copies of experience certificates Other relevant documents

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under UoL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 02 vacancies have been advertised: 01 for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 01 for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for UoL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc./M.Tech. in Remote Sensing, GIS, Geoinformatics or related discipline or M.Sc. in Horticulture/Agriculture with working knowledge of GIS, GPS and Drone Technology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess B.Sc. Agriculture with desirable knowledge of computer.

faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow receives Rs. 37,000/- per month + 10% HRA.

faq.answer: The Project Assistant receives 18000 per month fixed.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates are requested to submit their application along with a detailed CV and self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents on email id [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of the posts?
faq.answer: The duration of appointment is co-terminus with the project, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds (project duration is 3 years).

faq.question: Q9. Under which project are these posts being recruited?
